description: Walk germplasm ancestry or descendancy as a deduplicated DAG with cycle detection and depth limits. leafCount counts graph terminals, confirmedLeafCount counts successfully verified leaves, and frontier records unresolved directions. Nodes and edges each fit loadLimit and a 24,000-byte preview budget; trimmed discovered graphs and already-fetched omitted relatives are staged for brapi_dataframe_describe and brapi_dataframe_query (SQL). Diagrams describe only the discovered graph, never unvisited relatives.

alias.description: Connection alias. Omit to use alias `default`. An alias registered via brapi_connect works, and so does one the server has a URL configured for (a built-in alias, an operator-configured alias, or `default` on a deployment with a default server), which connects on first use. Calls that used a non-default alias must pass that same alias here.

diagram.description: Also return the walk as diagram source: `mermaid` (flowchart) or `dot` (Graphviz). Edges point parent → child, roots are bold, loop-closing edges are dashed. Omit for no diagram.

direction.description: Which direction to walk: ancestors (parents), descendants (progeny), or both — the union of the two walks. Ancestors are walked only upward and descendants only downward, so a descendant's other parent is not included.

germplasmDbIds.description: Starting germplasm (1–20 roots). All roots are walked concurrently.

loadLimit.description: Row ceiling for each inline graph/frontier preview, also bounded by a 24,000-byte budget. Omit for the deployment default. A first row exceeding the byte budget yields zero preview rows; retrieve narrower projections from the staged dataframe.

maxDepth.description: Max generations to walk per direction (default 3, cap 10).

name: brapi_walk_pedigree

confirmedLeafCount.description: Non-root nodes with successful empty lookups on every reached side; unresolved directions never confirm leaves.

cycleCount.description: Number of edges with isCycle: true. Paths that reconverge on one germplasm (shared ancestors, siblings, a parent shared by two roots) are not cycles.

deadEndCount.description: Nodes whose upstream pedigree/progeny lookup failed.

depthReached.description: Deepest BFS level that produced at least one new edge (0 if only roots were walked).

diagram.description: Requested Mermaid or DOT for the discovered graph, beyond previews; partial when capped. Omitted with a warning past 50,000 characters, or 500 edges for Mermaid.

direction.description: The direction the walk expanded (echoed from the input).

edges.description: One edge per discovered pair. Preview independently fits loadLimit and 24,000 bytes for array JSON and serialized row text; edgesDataframe retains omitted rows.

items.description: One parent–child pair, recorded once whichever side found it.

from.description: germplasmDbId of the source of the relationship.

isCycle.description: True when this edge closes a loop (the parent is already a descendant of the child); the walk does not continue past it. Absent on other edges.

parentType.description: The parent's role in the cross (e.g. MALE, FEMALE, SELF), when the upstream response supplies it.

relationship.description: Which lookup found the pair. parent = from is a parent of to (found via /pedigree); child = from is a child of to (found via /progeny). A pair found both ways is listed once, as parent.

edgesDataframe.description: Discovered edges when either preview is trimmed; truncated marks partial traversal. SQL renames from to from_; see columnLegend.

columnLegend.description: Sanitized column name → original upstream key, present only when a column was renamed to be SQL-safe (e.g. `end` → `end_`). SQL uses the sanitized names.

expiresAt.description: ISO 8601 time the dataframe metadata is purged; copy rows out before, or re-run the producing tool.

maxRows.description: Row cap that ended the pull, present only when that cap fired.

tableName.description: Table name for brapi_dataframe_describe and brapi_dataframe_query.

totalCount.description: Upstream-reported row total, when known; can exceed rowCount.

truncated.description: True when the dataframe holds less than the upstream reports: a cap, failed page, deadline, or short upstream ended the pull, or it was skipped. warnings says which. Absent otherwise.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `unknown_alias`: No connection is registered under the requested alias, and the server has no base URL configured for it to connect on first use. `auth_token_exchange_failed`: Connecting the alias on first use, the SGN or OAuth token exchange against the BrAPI /token endpoint failed. `auth_no_access_token`: Connecting the alias on first use, the token endpoint answered without returning an access token. `capability_discovery_unavailable`: Neither /serverinfo nor /calls listed any call, and at least one of them timed out, was unreachable, or answered 429 or a 5xx other than 501, so nothing was cached. `upstream_unauthorized`: The BrAPI server answered HTTP 401: it requires credentials, or rejected the ones sent. `upstream_forbidden`: The BrAPI server answered HTTP 403: the credentials sent, or their absence, lack access. `alias_base_url_invalid`: The base URL configured on the server for this alias is not an absolute http(s) URL, or carries credentials. `private_address_blocked`: The base URL configured for this alias, or its token URL, is on a private or reserved address this server may not reach. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

frontier.description: Bounded preview of unresolved directions; frontierDataframe retains omitted entries.

items.description: One unresolved expansion direction, distinct from a confirmed empty lookup.

error.description: Failure message for a failed expansion.

knownOmittedRelativeCount.description: Already-fetched relatives omitted from the discovered graph; absent when not requested or failed.

frontierCount.description: Unresolved node/side expansions across the full walk.

frontierDataframe.description: Every unresolved node/side expansion, with ordinal ordering.

columnLegend.description: Sanitized column name → original upstream key, present only when a column was renamed to be SQL-safe (e.g. `end` → `end_`). SQL uses the sanitized names.

expiresAt.description: ISO 8601 time the dataframe metadata is purged; copy rows out before, or re-run the producing tool.

tableName.description: Table name for brapi_dataframe_describe and brapi_dataframe_query.

knownOmittedRelativeCount.description: Distinct fetched relative IDs per expansion node/side omitted by safety limits; unrequested counts remain unknown.

leafCount.description: Non-root nodes with nothing recorded beyond them: ancestors with no parents, descendants with no progeny (a node on both sides needs neither). Includes nodes the depth limit stopped at.

maxDepth.description: The maximum depth the walk was allowed to reach (echoed from the input).

nodes.description: Discovered nodes sorted by depth/DbId. Preview fits loadLimit and 24,000 bytes for array JSON and serialized row text; nodesDataframe retains omitted rows.

items.description: One germplasm reached during the walk.

depth.description: Min distance from any root germplasm (0 for roots).

direction.description: `root` = a starting germplasm; `ancestor` = reached upward via /pedigree; `descendant` = reached downward via /progeny; `both` = reached from both sides (a descendant of one root and an ancestor of another, or a node on a pedigree loop).

isRoot.description: True when this node is one of the starting germplasm.

nodesDataframe.description: Discovered nodes when either preview is trimmed; truncated marks partial traversal. No unvisited relatives. JOIN germplasmDbId to the edge table on from_ or to.

columnLegend.description: Sanitized column name → original upstream key, present only when a column was renamed to be SQL-safe (e.g. `end` → `end_`). SQL uses the sanitized names.

expiresAt.description: ISO 8601 time the dataframe metadata is purged; copy rows out before, or re-run the producing tool.

maxRows.description: Row cap that ended the pull, present only when that cap fired.

tableName.description: Table name for brapi_dataframe_describe and brapi_dataframe_query.

totalCount.description: Upstream-reported row total, when known; can exceed rowCount.

truncated.description: True when the dataframe holds less than the upstream reports: a cap, failed page, deadline, or short upstream ended the pull, or it was skipped. warnings says which. Absent otherwise.

notice.description: Staged graph, frontier or omitted-relative tables and how to read them.

omittedRelativesDataframe.description: Fetched omitted relatives with ordinal, germplasmDbId, expansionNodeDbId and side; not an unvisited graph or resumable walk.

columnLegend.description: Sanitized column name → original upstream key, present only when a column was renamed to be SQL-safe (e.g. `end` → `end_`). SQL uses the sanitized names.

expiresAt.description: ISO 8601 time the dataframe metadata is purged; copy rows out before, or re-run the producing tool.

tableName.description: Table name for brapi_dataframe_describe and brapi_dataframe_query.

truncated.description: True when the walk hit its safety cap (1000 nodes or 10000 edges) before exhausting depth.

warnings.description: Advisory messages (capability gaps, per-node expansion failures, an omitted diagram).
